reason: Memo A is complete and upfront about the first-year cash gap (about $52,000 from members against $67,000–$84,000 from ads), and it gives a clear checkpoint. Memo B has unfilled blanks for retention, how to cover the gap and the ad sales lead's role, which the two board members from advertising would treat as a sign the plan isn't ready. A's mistake is calling the decline "about 20% a year" when the 36% fall happened in one year, but B makes the same timing mistake.
